recommendation_rule: Stated before computing. Among the capital-only candidates (baseline/reference policies, budget points, base+additions, reposition), take the non-dominated set on the selection-seed means (minimise simulated capital and material AOG h/yr) and its lower convex hull, sorted by capital. Walking up the hull, each segment's marginal value is the AOG-hour reduction per extra AED 1M of capital. The break-even value implied by the AOG penalty is h* = carrying % x AED 1M / (baseline AED per AOG hour), i.e. the AOG hours whose penalty equals the extra annual holding cost of AED 1M. The recommended 'balanced' point is the last hull vertex before the first segment whose marginal value falls below h* (equivalently the hull point that minimises carrying % x capital + AED/h x AOG hours). If no segment falls below h*, the highest-capital vertex is recommended and flagged 'frontier not saturated'.

flagged_more_than_doubles_p0.rule: rotable PN whose proposed network units > 2 x P0 units (or >= 2 when P0 holds 0); reason recorded per row in allocations.json

aog_desk_dependence: Every policy here, P0/P1/P2 included, leans on the engine's AOG-desk emergency buy (SIM-5: an expedited rotable arrives in at most 5 days at a 15% premium), which in practice means access to an AOG exchange/loan market; with that switched off, material AOG rises by one to two orders of magnitude for every policy (tornado row 'aog_desk_expedite off'), so the frontier is conditional on such a market existing for each PN.
